chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'I mingle with the people of distinction from the people, and I suffice with a little oil, so I wipe myself with it every day.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'I do not like that for you.' I said, 'A day and not a day?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'And I do not like that for you.' I said, 'One day, and not for two days?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'From Friday to Friday, one day or two days.'

key_terms.يَوْمٌ وَ يَوْمٌ لَا: One day and not one day (alternating)

ai.seo_question: How often should one wipe with oil for ritual purity according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) advises against the habitual daily use of oil for wiping, recommending instead a frequency of 'from Friday to Friday' (once a week) or occasionally once or twice. This guidance reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of *tayammum bi al-dahin* (dry ablution using oil) as a valid substitute for water when necessary, emphasizing moderation and avoiding excessive ritualism. The specific mention of Friday highlights the significance of the weekly congregational prayer in maintaining ritual purity.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I intermingle with the manly from the people and I have sufficed from the oil by the little bit, so I wipe with it every day’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not like that for you’. So I said, ‘A day and not a day (alternatively)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not like that for you’. I said, ‘One day, and not for two days?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Friday to the Friday, one day or two days’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I associate with careful people and content myself with a small amount of oil which I use little by little every day.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not like it for you.’ I then asked, ‘Should I then use one day and should not use the next day?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not like that for you.’ I then asked, ‘Can I use once after every two days?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘You can apply oil every Friday, once or twice a week.”’
